questions.question: When Jesus taught in the synagogue of His hometown, what did the astonished people ask about Him?

answers.text: Where His wisdom and powers came from
When He will heal the sick in town
How long He plans to stay in town

questions.question: The people in Jesus' hometown asked if He was the son of what kind of worker?
After His hometown took offense at Him, where did Jesus say a prophet is without honor?

answers.text: Only in his hometown and his own household
Only in big cities and royal courts
